title: Core Trio #07
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Thai woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, long glossy black waves, a poised, dramatic expression, cool and composed, sleek straight hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif — a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense engraved floral facets filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme silver platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Hawaiian woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, cool and composed, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, matte finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic — a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands following every deep crease, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.

Center woman's footwear: extreme carved cream sculptural heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Spanish woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, cheerful, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting — a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense folk-art florals filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 3, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
